description: Stable broken AX programs for single-round repair experiments.

cases.repair_goal: Insert the missing semicolon after the let binding.
cases.notes: Baseline parser recovery case.

cases.repair_goal: Insert the missing semicolon in lib/helper.ax without editing the rest of the project.
cases.notes: Project-backed syntax case that keeps src/main.ax and AX.toml as read-only repair context.

cases.repair_goal: Remove the stale dependency entry or point it at an existing local AX package directory.
cases.notes: Project-backed package resolver case where the repair target is AX.toml rather than an AX source file.

cases.repair_goal: Rename the dependency alias to a valid AX module root or remove the stale dependency entry.
cases.notes: Project-backed package resolver case for invalid dependency aliases that cannot become AX module roots.

cases.repair_goal: Remove the stale dependency entry or add a valid AX.toml manifest inside the dependency directory.
cases.notes: Project-backed package resolver case for a dependency directory that exists but is not a valid AX package.

cases.repair_goal: Remove the stale dependency entry or make the dependency package declare at least one AX source.
cases.notes: Project-backed package resolver case for dependency packages that do not declare any source files.

cases.repair_goal: Remove or rename the package dependency so every module root is owned by exactly one loaded source tree.
cases.notes: Project-backed package resolver case where a local support source and dependency alias both claim the same module root.

cases.repair_goal: Keep the local path package graph one level deep by removing or flattening the nested dependency.
cases.notes: Project-backed package resolver case for the v0 rule that dependencies cannot declare their own path dependencies.

cases.repair_goal: Remove the dependency source entry that duplicates the project entry or another loaded source.
cases.notes: Project-backed package resolver case for dependency sources that duplicate an already loaded project input.

cases.repair_goal: Close the if-condition with the missing right parenthesis.
cases.notes: Exercises balanced-parenthesis guidance and parser recovery into the following block.

cases.repair_goal: Add a valid AX entrypoint with the required main signature.
cases.notes: Covers the runnable-program contract.

cases.repair_goal: Rewrite main so it takes no parameters and returns i32.
cases.notes: Current AX prototype disallows main parameters.

cases.repair_goal: Make the declared type and initializer use the same AX type.
cases.notes: Validates exact-type diagnostics.

cases.repair_goal: Make each call argument produce the exact type declared by the target parameter.
cases.notes: Extends repair coverage to call-site type mismatches with a dedicated AI rule card.

cases.repair_goal: Rewrite the index expression so it produces an i32 value.
cases.notes: Extends exact-type diagnostics from bindings and call sites into array indexing.

cases.repair_goal: Make the condition expression evaluate to bool.
cases.notes: Covers control-flow conditions that incorrectly rely on implicit truthiness.

cases.repair_goal: Declare total before using it in the return expression.
cases.notes: Exercises scope-aware feedback.

cases.repair_goal: Use let mut or stop assigning to the immutable binding.
cases.notes: Covers the mutability contract.

cases.repair_goal: Add a return on the control-flow path that currently falls through.
cases.notes: Exercises function-context slicing for AI repair.

cases.repair_goal: Return a value whose type matches the function's declared return type.
cases.notes: Extends exact-type diagnostics into return statements with a dedicated rule card.

cases.repair_goal: Use `?` only on a Result value, or remove it when the expression already produces a plain value.
cases.notes: Covers the first `?` misuse class: postfix propagation on a non-Result expression.

cases.repair_goal: Make the enclosing helper return a compatible Result or replace `?` with explicit match handling.
cases.notes: Covers the second `?` misuse class: propagation inside a function that returns a plain value.

cases.repair_goal: Replace the missing type with a declared AX type or add the missing declaration.
cases.notes: Covers type-name resolution and the new type declaration rule card.

cases.repair_goal: Add the missing field initializer so the struct literal is complete.
cases.notes: Exercises struct-shape repair instead of scalar-only fixes.

cases.repair_goal: Replace the enum variant with one declared on the enum.
cases.notes: Covers enum-surface repairs and symbol-aware guidance.

cases.repair_goal: Match payload enum variants with an explicit payload binding or `_` ignore pattern.
cases.notes: Covers P2 match second-pass repair guidance for payload enum arm shape mistakes without cascading into exhaustiveness noise.

cases.repair_goal: Rewrite the match guard so the expression after `if` evaluates to bool.
cases.notes: Covers binding-aware match guard repair guidance without falling back to generic condition feedback.

cases.repair_goal: Rewrite the inclusive range pattern so the start bound is less than or equal to the end bound.
cases.notes: Covers i32 range pattern repair guidance for status-code and classifier style matches.

cases.repair_goal: Make the struct binding mutable before assigning to its field.
cases.notes: Extends mutability repairs from scalar locals to struct field writes.

cases.repair_goal: Replace the type name with a real runtime value, such as an enum variant.
cases.notes: Covers a common model mistake where a type name is used like a value.

cases.repair_goal: Remove or rename the duplicate local definition.
cases.notes: Provides a stable duplicate-definition repair target.

cases.repair_goal: Keep the array index within the declared fixed-size array bounds.
cases.notes: Covers runtime array bounds failures while keeping the static program valid.

cases.repair_goal: Guard the divisor or rewrite the calculation so the runtime divisor cannot be zero.
cases.notes: Extends the repair benchmark from static diagnostics into runtime failures.

cases.repair_goal: Guard the read with fs_is_file/fs_exists or switch to a path that is guaranteed to exist before reading.
cases.notes: Extends runtime repair coverage into host file-system failures while keeping the AX program statically valid.

cases.repair_goal: Use process_run when the command is allowed to fail, or rewrite the command so process_capture only sees a zero exit status.
cases.notes: Covers runtime process capture failures that should be repaired by switching to the status-oriented builtin or a successful command.

cases.repair_goal: Guard the directory read with fs_is_dir or switch to a directory path that is guaranteed to exist before reading.
cases.notes: Extends runtime repair coverage into host directory-enumeration failures while keeping the AX program statically valid.

cases.repair_goal: Remove the stray import or point it at a support module that actually exists in the current project.
cases.notes: Minimal module-mode benchmark case for imports that do not resolve to any declared support source.

cases.repair_goal: Remove the module declaration from the entry file so the manifest-owned root stays flat.
cases.notes: Minimal module-mode benchmark case for an entry file that incorrectly declares its own module path.

cases.repair_goal: Use an explicit zero-length array type like [i32; 0] for [], or provide elements when the target length is non-zero.
cases.notes: Empty array literals are only valid in explicit zero-length array context; non-zero-length targets still fail with S0032.

cases.repair_goal: Call len only with a string, fixed-size array, or slice value.
cases.notes: Covers the unified length helper added for traversal-oriented code.

cases.repair_goal: Slice an array or slice value instead of a scalar.
cases.notes: Covers a common traversal mistake where a non-sequence value is sliced.

cases.repair_goal: Declare the slice binding with `let mut` before assigning through an indexed slice element.
cases.notes: Covers mutable slice assignment while preserving the rule that assignment roots must be declared with `let mut`.

cases.repair_goal: Rewrite the struct match pattern so it lists every declared field exactly once.
cases.notes: Covers full-field shorthand struct destructuring, which is intentionally explicit for AI-readable repair.
